name: NovaHire
subtitle: Human-centered hiring workspace
description: A clearer way for hiring teams to understand candidates, move through decisions, and stay aligned.
challenge: Recruiting tools often scatter notes, pipeline stages, and feedback across several screens. This concept explores a focused interface that keeps the next decision obvious.
solution: A compact candidate pipeline, accessible review states, and a single candidate workspace for shared context.
features: Candidate pipeline with explicit status labels

name: RetailSense
subtitle: Readable commerce analytics
description: A data-rich retail dashboard that keeps everyday decisions understandable for store operators.
challenge: Busy store teams need a quick view of what matters without navigating dense reports or interpreting unclear charts.
solution: A purposeful information hierarchy with product performance, daily activity, and stock-level signals.

name: FinVision
subtitle: Calm financial planning interface
description: A planning and forecasting interface designed around clarity, confidence, and control.
challenge: Financial information can feel overwhelming when important assumptions and actions are buried in complex tables.
solution: An approachable dashboard with readable trends, comparison views, and plain-language summaries.
features: Modular views for teams and individuals

name: Atelier
subtitle: Editorial identity for a design practice
description: A visually expressive editorial website for a creative practice with an unmistakable point of view.
challenge: Creative studios need to communicate personality without losing usability or clarity of services.
solution: Expressive type, restrained motion, generous image space, and an intentional contact journey.

name: Northstar
subtitle: A modern knowledge platform
description: An approachable digital learning experience with a focus on discovery and continued progress.
challenge: Course catalogs can make exploration difficult when too many competing elements demand attention.
solution: A calm course discovery flow, helpful topic filters, and clearly visible learning pathways.

name: Fieldnotes
subtitle: Content-led publication experience
description: An independent publication concept with beautiful reading layouts and discoverable stories.
challenge: Editorial websites need to balance visual identity with fast navigation and uninterrupted reading.
solution: A modular article system, readable text rhythm, and lightweight content discovery.
